description: Select rows in the currently open sheet so the dashboard shows them selected and the same row ids can be used for a campaign later: exact rowIds, or filters and/or search (the sheet's Filtrar and Buscar; every filter must hold), e.g. the rows from SP with no active campaign. Up to 5000 rows. This changes web UI selection only; it does not delete or modify data.

field.description: uf, size (porte), cnae, role (cargo), employees (number range), signal (signal type), campaign, contact, import_miss, or column:<columnId> (the column ids the sheet rows list).

op.description: in: any of values (contact: all of them); contains / not_contains / is: text; empty / not_empty; between: min and/or max.

values.description: For in. campaign: none, no_active, active, paused, draft, ended or id:<campaignId>. contact: email, phone, linkedin, no_email, no_phone, no_linkedin.

search.description: Free text over name, company, role and e-mail, without accents.

name: select_sheet_rows
title: Selecionar linhas da planilha
